verdict.rationale: Jules works via GitHub repos and produces PRs/diffs, but there is no evidence of any data export feature, open-format export of tasks/history/settings, or account portability mechanism; the code itself already lives in the user's GitHub repo rather than being 'exported' from Jules. Missing for 10: any documented export tool, data-download feature, or open-format artifact of user data (task history, session logs, settings) that a user could take and leave with.
